reserveReview.reviewer: PoR verification sweep 2026-08 (R11 revisit; collateral API still unreconciled)
reserveReview.rationale: Re-checked 2026-08-08: the Monetrix collateral API still explicitly returns backing.reconciled=false (totalUsd 2,566,520.77 vs supply 2,562,093.17, collateralizationPct 100.17, status FULL_BACKED). The spotUsd, marginUsd, and signed bufferUsd breakdown does not present a non-double-counted reserve equation, and the positions API continues to mix spot value, perpetual notional, and negative idle-USDC. No reconciled reserve composition suitable for stable reserve slices has been published, so the single unlinked strategy and custody envelope is retained.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Monetrix's documented USDC mint input plus live but explicitly unreconciled strategy, collateral, and supply telemetry
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current non-double-counted spot, margin, hedge, idle-liquidity, custody, and redemption-backing amounts are not published as a reconciled reserve composition.
